reviewer: Codex inspection of actual exported/reimported images and mechanical evidence
findings: Refined prototype stage, not final production art or user approval. Actual front, rear, clay and side views show a compact SMG silhouette with an open trigger guard, profiled foregrip joined by a saddle, aligned bored barrel, connected stock struts and seated sights.

Complete ballistic magazine is forward of the finger space and fits a hollow, walled well. Independent exported-model checks pass ten sampled reload poses against receiver, well and guard; visible bolt travel and muzzle orientation also pass. Checks do not include hand IK or cartridge simulation.
Shared 1024 albedo/ORM atlas gives a dark coated body, bright metal barrel, patterned grip and bronze magazine; correctly oriented two-line stencils remain behind the ejection slot on both sides.

Private car/character comparison viewed: silhouette chamfers, actual functional openings and restrained markings support the project low-poly prototype stage. Richer weathering and game-view texture legibility remain later art work.
Shared first-eight world loot; neutral field-service materials do not assign an unapproved faction identity.
